meta.title: Meta Instagram App Approval & ANA Live Content Intelligence
meta.honesty_note: No Meta developer access, app, token or API call was available in this research session. No end-to-end test is claimed as passed. All runtime items are NOT_TESTED or BLOCKED.

executive_decision.decisive_condition: The person whose account is read must hold a role on the Meta app (admin, developer, or Instagram Tester).
evidence: Instagram Platform Overview, Access levels: 'If your app only serves your Instagram professional account or an account you manage, Standard Access is all your app needs.'
Instagram Platform Overview: 'If your app serves only your Instagram professional accounts, or accounts you manage, you do not need to implement a login flow.'
App Review Process: 'If your app will only be used by app users who have a role on the app itself, App Review is not required.'

permissions.dependencies_status: UNKNOWN - not stated on the Insights page

live_feed.decision: Polling only for the ANA pilot. Webhooks are a later extension, not an architecture assumption.

polling.new_post_detection: GET /<IG_USER_ID>/media?fields=id,timestamp&limit=25; follow pages until timestamp is older than the stored watermark. No documented sort guarantee, so compare the first page fully.
polling.pagination: Cursor-based via the returned paging object; follow next URL. Abort on: no next, watermark undercut, or hard page limit (default 20).
polling.delta_detection: NEW (unknown media_id) | CHANGED (known id, changed field hash) | MISSING (known id absent in a full pass)
polling.retry_backoff: Exponential 1s,2s,4s,8s,16s; max 5 attempts; jitter +/-20%; no retry on 4xx except 429; retry on 5xx and network errors

token_refresh.expired_token_recovery: Not recoverable; user must log in again -> status REAUTH_REQUIRED

polling.rate_limits: UNKNOWN from primary sources in this pass. Implementation: conservative (<=1 req/s, sequential) and log the rate-limit response headers Meta returns as the measurement basis. No guaranteed numbers claimed.
polling.error_handling: Log timestamp, endpoint, HTTP status, Meta error code/subcode, correlation id, token fingerprint (never the token).
polling.backfill: Watermark per account and resource type; single full scan after outage; missing insight windows re-fetched via since/until while inside the 90-day window.
polling.realtime_claim: Not claimed. Freshness equals polling interval plus run duration.

video_availability.platform_change_title: Download and copyright protections on media_url

omission_conditions.condition: Video contains copyrighted or licensed audio (including audio from the Instagram audio library) or is flagged for a copyright violation
omission_conditions.applies_to: all video media: reels, video posts, video stories

omission_conditions.condition: Reel owner turned off downloads (account-level or per-reel 'Allow people to download your reels')
omission_conditions.applies_to: reels only, only on endpoints reading other users' media
omission_conditions.explicitly_not_affected: GET /<IG_USER_ID>/media and GET /<IG_MEDIA_ID> for own media
omission_conditions.evaluated_against: the reel's owner, so it can apply to a co-authored reel

further_facts: All other media fields (id, permalink, caption, timestamp) are returned as normal
Image media and carousel containers are not affected; a carousel's video children can be
Official guidance: treat media_url as optional; fall back to permalink or thumbnail_url
Applies to both graph.facebook.com and graph.instagram.com
Nested media via field expansion inherit the conditions of the originating request

early_warning_field.name: media_audio_type
early_warning_field.returned_for: video media such as Reels only
early_warning_field.use: Predicts media_url availability before attempting a download

video_availability.diagnostic_field: copyright_check_information.status (completed | error | in_progress | not_started), matches_found, copyright_matches with matched_segments.segment_type AUDIO|VIDEO and owner_copyright_policy actions BLOCK|MUTE

feed_video_or_reel.media_url: missing when licensed audio or copyright flag, even for own media

reel_with_downloads_disabled.media_url: not affected when reading own media via /media or /<ID>; missing on foreign-read endpoints

collaborative_post.media_url: download setting of the reel owner applies; can affect the co-author

fallback_chain: 1. Always import metadata (id, permalink, shortcode, timestamp, media_type, comments_count, like_count, media_audio_type, is_ai_generated, caption*)
2. Check media_url -> AVAILABLE or MISSING_LICENSED_AUDIO; never an import failure
3. Match an own original from the archive: manual link > permalink > timestamp+media_type+duration; set LOCAL_ARCHIVE or MISSING_NO_ARCHIVE_MATCH
4. Transcribe and analyse only AVAILABLE or LOCAL_ARCHIVE; otherwise placeholder 'transcript not available - source missing'
5. Never fabricate missing content with AI; every field carries an availability_status

privacy_and_security.key_clarification: Ana's consent to connect her own account is not a legal basis for processing personal data of third parties, especially commenters who never consented to processing by ANA.

meta_side_obligations.duty: Data deletion request callback: signed POST with app-scoped user id; response must be JSON containing url and a confirmation code
Deauthorization callback URL configurable in the dashboard
Permission must be regranted after 90 days of non-use
Analytics/marketing use only aggregated, de-identified or anonymised, and not re-identifiable
App secret never client-side; long-lived token exchange server-side

pilot_minimum_standard: Processing-record entry: source, purpose, access, retention, correction path, deletion path, observation vs inference
Short privacy policy on a publicly reachable HTTPS page
Data deletion request URL implemented from the start
Retention: raw media 24 months, insights 12 months (justified by the 90-day user-metrics window), AI derivations until revocation
One-click revocation path: disconnect -> discard token -> delete data -> confirm
Token security: server-side only, secret store, fingerprint in logs, rotation on suspicion
extended_standard_for_external_users: DPA with every AI provider and hoster
Data-subject-rights process for commenters with a reachable contact point
Written lawfulness assessment per data type before first import
Schedule the Data Use Checkup (annual, CONDITIONAL)
Complete Data Handling Questions when Meta requests them
Deletion cascade: Meta request -> own store -> backups -> derived embeddings
Privacy by design: comments as hash plus aggregate; plaintext only transiently
token_storage: Never in logs - SHA-256 fingerprint (first 8 hex chars) only
Never in Git (.gitignore already covers .env*, private/, transcripts/, recordings/, exports/private/)
Rotation immediately on suspicion, regularly via the 60-day refresh

mvp_architecture.google_sheets_reason: No safe token location, no idempotent upserts, no deletion endpoint, no cursor pagination handling. Useful as a view, not as a store.
mvp_architecture.recommended: Small worker plus SQLite (pilot) or a managed database (once a public endpoint or webhooks are needed)
tables: semantic_cluster (AI derivations, kept separate from raw data)
mvp_architecture.ai_separation_rule: AI derivations live in their own table carrying source_media_ids, model, prompt version, created_at, reviewer and falsification_condition; never merged with raw Meta data.
mvp_architecture.api_contract_excluded: Anything requiring media_product_type, reposts_count, saved_count, shares_count, total_*, hashtag search or business discovery - not available under Instagram Login.
